# Gevurah Pass — Realistic Verification Boundaries

## Must prove now
- Current main lineage contains Better V2 or identify exact conflicting deltas.
- Current route/call-site inventory.
- All deterministic browser/server API contracts.
- Image add, replace, remove, preview invalidation, persistence, and outgoing payload behavior.
- Public safe API paths and production UI/browser behavior.
- No secret exposure.

## External boundary
Real paid MiniMax generation requires a configured production `MINIMAX_API_KEY`. If production remains `configured:false`, prove every pre-upstream contract and explicitly leave only paid upstream success blocked.

## Mutation rule
Do not modify source unless inspection or tests reveal a concrete gap. If a gap exists, rewrite whole files only, preserve tabs, keep files below 120 lines, add Awtsmoos/Awtsmoos.com documentation, and rerun all affected regressions before release.
